threads.body: [Testing] Moving the reporter tests into `testMetrics` leaves them out of metadata collection because `.github/scripts/instrumentations.sh:354-356` still lists only the three variants that now exclude them. Add `kafka:kafka-clients:kafka-clients-0.11:javaagent:testMetrics` to `TEST_LATEST_DEPS_INSTRUMENTATIONS` to preserve collection of supported metrics, as required by `instrumentation-docs/readme.md:13-19`. Leave `metadataConfig` unset for this whole-module enablement, per `.github/instructions/instrumentation-gradle.instructions.md:68-69`.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  [Testing] Keep the metrics variant in metadata collection**

When `instrumentation-docs/collect.sh` runs, it still invokes only the Kafka agent `test`, `testExperimental`, and `testReceiveTelemetry` tasks listed at `.github/scripts/instrumentations.sh:354-356`; none now enables native metrics. The script also deletes the module's `.telemetry` directory first, so the next regeneration drops the supported `kafka.*` metric inventory altogether. `.github/instructions/instrumentation-gradle.instructions.md` requires collecting “default telemetry and supported non-default telemetry modes.” Add `testMetrics` to `TEST_LATEST_DEPS_INSTRUMENTATIONS` so making metrics default-off does not stop documenting them.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L20-L24](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/blob/89d4d3b705bad2504ee31c1a758d899b0d42572e/AGENTS.md#L20-L24)
